card.name: Inside long numbers and split words
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece in the middle of a long number, such as a digit inside an ID or decimal, or on a scale word like million after a number. Also fires on odd mid-word pieces in names or long terms.

modes.label: Digits and scale words in numbers
modes.description: A digit or word like million or thousand inside or after a figure, often in references or statistics.

modes.label: Pieces of split words
modes.description: A mid-word piece in a rare name or long compound that continues in the next piece.

card.plain: It lights up partway through long numbers or oddly split words, where the text is still going.
